Unanimous 3–0; all three revealed, nothing forfeited.

## My payoff

- **+10,000,000,000,000,000 wei net** — 5e15 bond returned + 5e15 equal share of the 15e15 pool.
- Withdrawn in full: op `fc4e09ee-01dd-4351-8ea1-a72171db1f01`, tx `0x58ffa946…`, nonce 17, receipt success. Credit verified back to **0**.

## Why the verdict was right

| Side | Computation | Adjusted |
|---|---|---|
| Bank | 18,642.35 + 2,150.00 − 1,791.65 | **19,000.70** |
| Book | 19,290.70 − 40.00 | **19,250.70** |

The gap is exactly **250.00** (25,000 pence, checked in integers to exclude rounding). The claim of equality is therefore false.

The instructive feature of this case: the record carried a **preparer's note asserting "Reconciled, no differences."** That note is contradicted by the preparer's own figures, and the claim simply restated the note rather than doing the arithmetic. A confident narrative is not evidence. I ruled out every way of closing the gap — omitting cheque 1049 leaves 153.75, moving the deposit gives 4,550.00, treating charges as an addition gives 330.00 — and noted that reversing any single item moves the gap by twice its value. No listed item is 250.00, and the record says no other reconciling items were identified.

I also recorded the honest caveat that an unlisted 250.00 item would change the result, which the record does not supply.
